content: विचारः .²1 Reflection, deliberation, thought, consideration; विचारमार्गप्रहितेन चक्षुषा <ls>Ku. 5. 42</ls>. .²2 Examination, discussion, investigation; तत्त्वार्थविचार. .²3 Trial (of a case); विषसलिलतुलाग्निप्रार्थिते मे विचारे <ls>Mk. 9. 43</ls>. .²4 Judgment, discrimination, discernment, exercise of reason; विचारमूढः प्रतिभासि मे त्वम् <ls>R. 2. 47</ls>. .²5 Decision, determination. .²6 Selection. .²7 Doubt, hesitation. .²8 Prudence, circumspection.
